name: Soul Binding
description: Melee Spell Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points from this attack dies and has its soul imprisoned in one of the creature’s eyes. The target can’t be revived by any means short of a wish spell until the creature is destroyed.
